column1: # LOCK-COMBAT-0002: every third class at level 85, in the Vesper set its armour category names (its own, or its nearest ancestor's), auto-attacking a Maluk Warlord in front of it with nothing and with each Vesper weapon,

# as the client's attack request starts it (AI attack intention), the world stepped until 4 hits have landed or missed, on the stream (1, "lock.combat.auto", class * 100 + weapon), weapon 0 being none.
# Hits are millis:damage, ! marking a critical, or millis:miss, millis from the attack request. MP and ammunition spent are over the whole case.
# A hit that lands for 0 damage notifies nothing (Creature.onHitTimer), so it shows only as a gap: a fighter's bare fists do that to a Warlord, and such cases run to the 30 s limit.
